ui_help23.source: Choose a tab to show its controls. View starts with Navigate; Draw contains Drawing, Selection and Insert. Navigate pans without drawing; pinch with two fingers to zoom. The arrow beside the tabs collapses the panel. All tools have labels. Edit changes the selection, canvas bounds, dimensions or image. Color selects foreground and background colors; Swap colors exchanges them and Black / white resets them. The color picker previews your choice immediately. Use colour confirms it; Cancel restores the previous color. Add colour or tap an empty saved slot to choose and save a colour. Hold a saved colour to edit or remove it. Advanced opens the detailed editor beside Black / white. Pixel grid also shows image-pixel rulers; cursor drawing shows live x/y beside zoom. Save as chooses an image format, compression settings and location; Save writes there again using those settings. Export as creates ICO, ASCII art or Base64 text without marking the drawing saved. Save and share saves a copy, then opens Android sharing. It keeps your current Save destination. Draw > Insert > Other images contains device files, Catrobat, Irasutoya, Openclipart and “Wikimedia Commons · Blank maps…”. Inserted images remain selected; the view shows their handles even outside the canvas. Fit image to canvas changes placement; Original size restores the source dimensions. Autosave restores the draft and both undo/redo stacks when you reopen the app. File also contains image assembly, How to use, and About, licences & credits. Insert text supports horizontal and vertical writing.
ui_help23.wording:
Atyik un tab para u fanmamostra i ramienta-ña. «Atan» tutuhun gi «Muebi i mostra»; gi «Dibuhu» guaha «Dibuhu», «Sileksión» yan «Na'hålum». «Muebi i mostra» ha muebi i mostra sin dibuhu. Na'hihot pat na'chågu' i dos na kålulot para un tulaika i zoom. I flecha gi fi'on i tab siha ha na'attuk i panel. Guaha na'an kada ramienta. Usa «Tulaika» para un tulaika i påtti ni ma'atyik, i kåntun brin, i mineddung, pat i pinenta.

Gi «Kulot» siña un atyik i kulot para un fa'tinas pinenta (FG) yan i kulot para i brin (BG). «Tulaika i lugåt i kulot siha» ha tulaika i lugåt i dos; «Na'åttilong yan na'å'paka' ta'lu» ha na'ta'lu i dos na kulot. I ramienta para un atyik kulot ha na'annuk ensegidas i kulot ni un atyik. «Usa kulot» ha aksepta i inatyik; «Kansela» ha na'ta'lu i primet na kulot. Usa «Na'halom kulot» pat patcha un lugåt ni tåya' kulot para un atyik yan po'lu un kulot. Patcha ya go'ti un kulot ni mapo'lu para un tulaika pat na'suha. «Mås inatyik siha» gaigi gi fi'on «Na'åttilong yan na'å'paka' ta'lu». Ha baba i editor ni guaha mås inatyik para i kulot.

«Råya siha gi kantun kada pixel» ha na'annuk lokkui' i regla para i pixels gi pinenta. Yanggin un usa i cursor para un fa'tinas pinenta, mamostra i lugåt-ña (X/Y) gi fi'on i zoom ya matulaika an mamuyi i cursor.

«Po'lu kumu…» para un atyik i klåsin dokumentu, i inatyik para u mafa'dikiki' i dokumentu, yan i lugåt para u mapo'lu. «Po'lu» ha po'lu ta'lu gi mesmu na lugåt yan i mesmu na inatyik siha. «Po'lu un sahngi na kopia…» ha fa'tinas un dokumentu ICO, un pinenta gi tinige' ASCII, pat un tinige' Base64; ti ha marka i dibuhu kumu mapo'lu. «Po'lu yan kumpåtti» ha po'lu un kopia, pues baba i inatyik Android para un kumpåtti. Ti matulaika i lugåt ni ma'usa på'gu para «Po'lu».

Gi «Dibuhu > Na'hålum > Otro siha na imåhen» guaha dokumentu ginin i tråstis, Catrobat, Irasutoya, Openclipart yan «Wikimedia Commons · Mapa siha ni tåya' tinige'…». I pinenta ni mana'hålum ma'atyik trabiha. Mamostra i go'tihan-ña maskeseha gaigi gi huyong i brin. «Tulaika i mineddung i pinenta para u hålum gi brin» ha tulaika i lugåt-ña gi brin; «Urihinåt na mineddong» ha na'ta'lu i mineddung i urihinåt na pinenta.

An un baba ta'lu i app, i autosave ha na'ta'lu i kopia para cho'chu' yan i rekot para un na'lo gi estådo åntis pat un rinueba i tinilaika. Gi «Dokumentu» guaha lokkui' «Dinanña' i pinenta siha», «Taimanu para un usa AN Paint» yan «Put AN Paint, lisensia siha, yan håyi fuma'tinas». Siña un na'hålum tinige' gi banda pat disdi sanhilu' asta sanpapa'.

ui_add_up_to_20_images_with_android_s.source:
Add up to 20 images with Android's file picker. The bottom tray shows thumbnails, filenames, image dimensions after cropping and any Same width or Same height adjustment, and file modification times when supplied by the provider. Sort by filename or modification time; sorting does not rearrange placed images.

Tap a thumbnail to select it. Crop image trims that image; Batch crop applies pixel or percentage margins to selected images. Drag crop handles or type amounts. Reset crop restores the original edges. Cropping is non-destructive and can be undone.

Hold a thumbnail, or drag an image already in the workspace, then drop it onto a highlighted edge. The translucent preview shows the exact snapped result. A right attachment aligns the tops; a bottom attachment aligns the left edges. You can also tap a thumbnail and then a + target. When snapping, the first image starts at the origin. Attached images may move when their parent is cropped. Overlaps are rejected when snapping.

Select an image and use Exact position to set its top-left X/Y coordinates in whole pixels, starting at zero. Other images keep their positions, and overlaps are allowed.

Same width and Same height give every input a common dimension while preserving each image's own aspect ratio. Choose pixels, percent, Smallest or Largest. Restore original sizes removes normalization and keeps crops.

Unplace returns only the selected image to the tray. Other images stay placed; attached images may move to fill the gap. Remove deletes only that input. Undo/Redo restore these changes. Drag a placed image to rearrange it; empty-space dragging pans. Pinch to zoom. «Show all» adjusts the zoom to show the whole assembly; it never changes output dimensions.

Save PNG saves the assembled image directly. Edit in Paint transfers it into the main editor as an undoable replacement. If the output exceeds the memory budget, choose a smaller output copy if offered. If even a tiny output exceeds the budget, the app shows a memory warning instead of a size chooser. Original source files stay unchanged. The current assembly is stored locally and reopens when you return.

This mode uses the same Catrobat/AGPL and asset credits shown in the main editor's «File > About, licences & credits» panel.

ui_help23.source: Choose a tab to show its controls. View starts with Navigate; Draw contains Drawing, Selection and Insert. Navigate pans without drawing; pinch with two fingers to zoom. The arrow beside the tabs collapses the panel. All tools have labels. Edit changes the selection, canvas bounds, dimensions or image. Color selects foreground and background colors; Swap colors exchanges them and Black / white resets them. The color picker previews your choice immediately. Use colour confirms it; Cancel restores the previous color. Add colour or tap an empty saved slot to choose and save a colour. Hold a saved colour to edit or remove it. Advanced opens the detailed editor beside Black / white. Pixel grid also shows image-pixel rulers; cursor drawing shows live x/y beside zoom. Save as chooses an image format, compression settings and location; Save writes there again using those settings. Export as creates ICO, ASCII art or Base64 text without marking the drawing saved. Save and share saves a copy, then opens Android sharing. It keeps your current Save destination. Draw > Insert > Other images contains device files, Catrobat, Irasutoya, Openclipart and “Wikimedia Commons · Blank maps…”. Inserted images remain selected; the view shows their handles even outside the canvas. Fit image to canvas changes placement; Original size restores the source dimensions. Autosave restores the draft and both undo/redo stacks when you reopen the app. File also contains image assembly, How to use, and About, licences & credits. Insert text supports horizontal and vertical writing.
ui_help23.wording: ⵙⵜⵉ ⵢⴰⵜ ⵜⴼⵔⴰⵡⵜ ⴰⴷ ⵜⵙⴽⵏⴷ ⵜⵉⵙⵖⴰⵍ ⵏⵏⵙ. «ⵙⴽⵏ» ⵉⵙⵙⵏⵜⴰ ⵙ «ⵙⵎⵓⵜⵜⵢ ⵜⴰⵎⵓⵖⵍⵉ»; ⴳ «ⴰⵙⵙⵓⵏⵖ» ⵍⵍⴰⵏ «ⴰⵙⵙⵓⵏⵖ», «ⴰⵙⵜⵉ» ⴷ «ⴰⵙⵙⴽⵛⵎ». ⵙⵎⵓⵜⵜⵢ ⵜⴰⵎⵓⵖⵍⵉ ⴱⵍⴰ ⴰⵙⵙⵓⵏⵖ; ⵙⵎⵓⵏ ⵏⵉⵖ ⵙⴱⴹⵓ ⵙⵉⵏ ⵉⴹⵓⴹⴰⵏ ⵉ ⵓⵙⵏⴼⵍ ⵏ ⵓⵙⵙⵉⵎⵖⵓⵔ. ⵜⴰⵡⵙⵔⵎⵜ ⵉⴷⵉⵙ ⵏ ⵜⴼⵔⴰⵡⵉⵏ ⴷⴰ ⵜⵙⵏⵓⴹⵓ ⵜⴰⴼⵔⴰⵡⵜ ⵏ ⵜⵉⵙⵖⴰⵍ. ⴽⵓ ⴰⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵖⵓⵔⵙ ⵉⵙⵎ. «ⵙⵏⴼⵍ» ⴷⴰ ⵉⵙⵏⴼⴰⵍ ⴰⵙⵜⵉ, ⵉⵔⴰⵏ ⵏ ⵓⴷⵖⴰⵔ ⵏ ⵓⵙⵙⵓⵏⵖ, ⵜⵉⴷⴷⵉⵜⵉⵏ ⵏⵉⵖ ⵜⴰⵡⵍⴰⴼⵜ. ⵙ «ⴰⴽⵍⵓ» ⴷⴰ ⵜⵙⵜⴰⵢⴷ ⵉⴽⵍⴰⵏ ⵏ ⵡⴰⵢⴰⵡⴰⵙ ⴰⵎⵣⵡⴰⵔⵓ ⴷ ⵡⴰⵢⴰⵡⴰⵙ ⴰⵎⴷⴼⵉⵔ; ⵣⵎⵔⴷ ⴰⴷ ⵜⵎⵙⵏⴼⵍⴷ ⴰⴽⵓⴷ ⵏ ⵙⵉⵏ, ⵏⵉⵖ ⴰⴷ ⵜⵙⵙⵓⴽⵏⴷ ⵉⴽⵍⴰⵏ ⵏ ⵜⵣⵡⵓⵔⵉ ⵙ «ⴰⴱⵔⴽⴰⵏ / ⴰⵎⵍⵍⴰⵍ». ⴰⵙⵜⵉ ⵏ ⵓⴽⵍⵓ ⴷⴰ ⵉⵙⴽⴰⵏ ⴰⵙⵜⵉ ⵏⵏⴽ ⴷⵖⵉ. «ⵙⵎⵔⵙ ⴰⴽⵍⵓ» ⴷⴰ ⵉⵙⵏⵏⴰⵍ ⴰⵙⵜⵉ; «ⵙⵙⵔ» ⴷⴰ ⵉⵙⵙⵓⴽⵓⵏ ⴰⴽⵍⵓ ⵏ ⴷⴰⵜ. ⵙⵎⵔⵙ «ⵔⵏⵓ ⴰⴽⵍⵓ» ⵏⵉⵖ ⵙⵉⵜ ⵅⴼ ⵓⴷⵖⴰⵔ ⵉⵅⵡⴰⵏ ⴰⴷ ⵜⵙⵜⵉⴷ ⵓⵍⴰ ⴰⴷ ⵜⵃⴹⵓⴷ ⴰⴽⵍⵓ. ⵙⵉⵜ, ⵟⵟⴼ ⴰⴽⵍⵓ ⵉⵜⵜⵡⴰⵃⴹⴰⵏ ⴰⴷ ⵜⵙⵏⴼⵍⴷ ⵏⵉⵖ ⴰⴷ ⵜ ⵜⴽⴽⵙⴷ. «ⵜⵉⵙⵖⴰⵍ ⵢⴰⴹⵏ» ⴰⴷⵉⵙ ⵏ «ⴰⴱⵔⴽⴰⵏ / ⴰⵎⵍⵍⴰⵍ» ⴷⴰ ⵜⵜⵕⵥⵎⵏⵜ ⵜⵉⵙⵖⴰⵍ ⵜⵉⵎⵙⴰⵔⵉⵏ. «ⵉⵣⵔⵉⵔⵏ ⴳⵔ ⵉⴷ ⴱⵉⴽⵙⵍ» ⴷⴰ ⵙⵙⴽⴰⵏⵏ ⴰⵡⴷ ⵜⵉⵙⵖⵍⵉⵏ ⵏ ⵓⵙⴽⵜⵉ ⵙ ⵉⴷ ⴱⵉⴽⵙⵍ. «ⴰⵙⵙⵓⵏⵖ ⵙ ⵜⵎⴰⵜⴰⵔⵜ ⵏ ⵓⴷⵖⴰⵔ» ⴷⴰ ⵉⵙⴽⴰⵏ x/y ⴷⵖⵉ ⴰⴷⵉⵙ ⵏ ⵓⵙⵙⵉⵎⵖⵓⵔ. «ⵃⴹⵓ ⴰⵎ…» ⴷⴰ ⵉⵜⵜⴰⴽⴽⴰ ⴰⵙⵜⵉ ⵏ ⵡⴰⵏⴰⵡ, ⵜⵉⵙⵖⴰⵍ ⵏ ⵓⵙⵙⵉⵎⵥⵉ ⴷ ⵓⴷⵖⴰⵔ. «ⵃⴹⵓ» ⴷⴰ ⵉⵃⵟⵟⵓ ⴷⵉⵏ ⴷⵉⵖ ⵙ ⵜⵉⵙⵖⴰⵍ ⴰ. «ⵙⵙⵓⴼⵖ ⴰⵎ…» ⴷⴰ ⵉⵙⵏⵓⵍⴼⵓ ICO, ⴰⵙⵙⵓⵏⵖ ASCII ⵏⵉⵖ ⴰⴹⵕⵉⵙ Base64, ⴱⵍⴰ ⴰⴷ ⵉⵙⴽⵏ ⵉⵙ ⵉⵜⵜⵡⴰⵃⴹⴰ ⵓⵙⵙⵓⵏⵖ. «ⵃⴹⵓ, ⵜⴱⴹⵓⴷ…» ⴷⴰ ⵉⵃⵟⵟⵓ ⵜⵓⵏⵖⵉⵍⵜ, ⵉⵕⵥⵎ ⴰⴱⵟⵟⵓ ⵏ Android. ⵓⵔ ⴷⴰ ⵉⵙⵏⴼⴰⵍ ⴰⴷⵖⴰⵔ ⵏ «ⵃⴹⵓ». «ⴰⵙⵙⵓⵏⵖ > ⴰⵙⵙⴽⵛⵎ > ⵜⵉⵡⵍⴰⴼⵉⵏ ⵢⴰⴹⵏ» ⵉⵍⵍⴰ ⴷⵉⴳⵙ ⵉⴼⵓⵢⵍⴰ ⵏ ⵓⵍⵍⴰⵍ, Catrobat, Irasutoya, Openclipart ⴷ «Wikimedia Commons · ⵜⵉⴽⴰⵕⴹⵉⵡⵉⵏ ⵓⵔ ⴷⵉⵙⵏⵜ ⴰⴹⵕⵉⵙ…». ⵜⵉⵡⵍⴰⴼⵉⵏ ⵉⵜⵜⵓⵙⴽⵛⵎⵏⵉⵏ ⴷⴰ ⵇⵇⵉⵎⵏⵜ ⵙ ⵓⵙⵜⵉ. ⵜⴰⵎⵓⵖⵍⵉ ⴷⴰ ⵜⵙⴽⴰⵏ ⵉⵎⴰⵟⵟⴰⴼⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏⵜ ⴰⵡⴷ ⴱⵕⵕⴰ ⵏ ⵓⴷⵖⴰⵔ ⵏ ⵓⵙⵙⵓⵏⵖ. «ⵙⵎⵙⴰⵙⴰ ⵜⴰⵡⵍⴰⴼⵜ ⴷ ⵓⴷⵖⴰⵔ ⵏ ⵓⵙⵙⵓⵏⵖ» ⴷⴰ ⵉⵙⵏⴼⴰⵍ ⴰⴷⵖⴰⵔ; «ⵜⵉⴷⴷⵉ ⵜⴰⵏⴰⵚⵍⵉⵜ» ⴷⴰ ⵉⵙⵙⵓⴽⵓⵏ ⵜⵉⴷⴷⵉⵜⵉⵏ ⵏ ⵓⵙⴰⴳⵎ. ⴰⵃⵟⵟⵓ ⴰⵡⵔⵎⴰⵏ ⴷⴰ ⵉⵙⵙⵓⴽⵓⵏ ⴰⵙⵙⵓⵏⵖ ⴷ ⵉⵎⵓⵖⵏ ⵏ ⵓⵙⵙⴰⵔ ⴷ ⵓⵙⵙⵓⴽⵏ ⵎⴽ ⵜⵕⵥⵎⴷ AN Paint ⴷⵉⵖ. ⴳ «ⴰⴼⴰⵢⵍⵓ» ⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴰⵡⴷ «ⴰⵙⵎⵓⵏ ⵏ ⵜⵡⵍⴰⴼⵉⵏ…», «ⵎⴰⵎⴽ ⴰⴷ ⵜⵙⵎⵔⵙⴷ» ⴷ «ⵖⴼ AN Paint, ⵉⵣⵔⴼⴰⵏ ⴷ ⵉⵎⴳⴰⵢⵏ». ⴰⵙⵙⴽⵛⵎ ⵏ ⵓⴹⵕⵉⵙ ⵉⵙⵎⴰⵏⴰⵢ ⵜⵉⵔⵔⴰ ⵙ ⵉⵣⵔⵉⵔⵏ ⵉⵏⵉⴳⴷⴰⵏⵏ ⵏⵉⵖ ⵙⴳ ⵓⴼⵍⵍⴰ ⵖⵔ ⵡⴰⴷⴷⴰ.

ui_add_up_to_20_images_with_android_s.source:
Add up to 20 images with Android's file picker. The bottom tray shows thumbnails, filenames, image dimensions after cropping and any Same width or Same height adjustment, and file modification times when supplied by the provider. Sort by filename or modification time; sorting does not rearrange placed images.

Tap a thumbnail to select it. Crop image trims that image; Batch crop applies pixel or percentage margins to selected images. Drag crop handles or type amounts. Reset crop restores the original edges. Cropping is non-destructive and can be undone.

Hold a thumbnail, or drag an image already in the workspace, then drop it onto a highlighted edge. The translucent preview shows the exact snapped result. A right attachment aligns the tops; a bottom attachment aligns the left edges. You can also tap a thumbnail and then a + target. When snapping, the first image starts at the origin. Attached images may move when their parent is cropped. Overlaps are rejected when snapping.

Select an image and use Exact position to set its top-left X/Y coordinates in whole pixels, starting at zero. Other images keep their positions, and overlaps are allowed.

Same width and Same height give every input a common dimension while preserving each image's own aspect ratio. Choose pixels, percent, Smallest or Largest. Restore original sizes removes normalization and keeps crops.

Unplace returns only the selected image to the tray. Other images stay placed; attached images may move to fill the gap. Remove deletes only that input. Undo/Redo restore these changes. Drag a placed image to rearrange it; empty-space dragging pans. Pinch to zoom. «Show all» adjusts the zoom to show the whole assembly; it never changes output dimensions.

Save PNG saves the assembled image directly. Edit in Paint transfers it into the main editor as an undoable replacement. If the output exceeds the memory budget, choose a smaller output copy if offered. If even a tiny output exceeds the budget, the app shows a memory warning instead of a size chooser. Original source files stay unchanged. The current assembly is stored locally and reopens when you return.

This mode uses the same Catrobat/AGPL and asset credits shown in the main editor's «File > About, licences & credits» panel.
ui_add_up_to_20_images_with_android_s.wording:
Yungh giz senj vwnzgen Android gya haeuj ceiq lai 20 aen dozsiengq. Banj baih laj yienh’ok dozsiengq iq, mingz vwnzgen, gij cikconq laeng daet henz roxnaeuz gaij ciuq «Gvangq doxdoengz» roxnaeuz «Sang doxdoengz», caeuq seizgan coihgaij vwnzgen danghnaeuz giz hawj vwnzgen miz. Baiz ciuq mingz vwnzgen roxnaeuz seizgan coihgaij. Baiz neix mbouj gaij vih dozsiengq gaenq baij haenx.

Diemj aen dozsiengq iq daeuj senj de. «Daet henz dozsiengq» daet henz aen dozsiengq haenx. «Daet henz lai dozsiengq» daet henz gij dozsiengq senj haenx ciuq diap diemj saek dozsiengq roxnaeuz beijlaeh moix bak faenh. Rag giz gaemz daet henz roxnaeuz sij gij soq. «Caiq yungh daengx dozsiengq» hoizfuk gij henz yienzlaiz. Daet henz mbouj haih dozsiengq yienzlaiz, caeuq siu ndaej.

Gaemz aen dozsiengq iq, roxnaeuz rag aen dozsiengq gaenq youq ndaw dieg guhsaeh, caiq cuengq youq henz yienh’ok haenx. Gij yawj sien roengzdiemj haenx yienh’ok coh ciep laengde cinj. Ciep youq baih gvaz hawj henz baih gwnz doxndaengz; ciep youq baih laj hawj henz baih swix doxndaengz. Hix diemj aen dozsiengq iq, caiq diemj giz + ndaej. Mwh hawj dozsiengq ciep, aen daih’it haidaeuz youq diemj 0, 0. Dangh daet henz aen dozsiengq hawj dozsiengq wnq ciep haenx, gij dozsiengq ciep giz de haenx hoengjlau yaek doengh. Mwh ciep mbouj hawj dozsiengq doxdep.

Senj aen dozsiengq caeuq yungh «Vih cinj» dingh X/Y gok gwnz baih swix ciuq cingjsoq diemj saek dozsiengq, haidaeuz daj 0. Dozsiengq wnq mbouj doengh, caeuq hawj dozsiengq doxdep ndaej.

«Gvangq doxdoengz» caeuq «Sang doxdoengz» hawj dozsiengq haeuj haenx miz gij cikconq doxdoengz, hoeng moix aen lij baujlouz gij beijlaeh gvangq caeuq sang gag miz. Senj diemj saek dozsiengq, beijlaeh moix bak faenh, «Ceiq iq» roxnaeuz «Ceiq hung». «Caiq yungh gij cikconq yienzlaiz» siu gij gaij hawj cikconq doxdoengz, hoeng lij baujlouz gij daet henz.

Cij aeu aen dozsiengq senj haenx ok daj dieg baij, dauq youq banj baih laj. Dozsiengq wnq lij youq ndaw dieg baij; gij dozsiengq ciep giz de haenx hoengjlau yaek doengh daeuj ndaemh giz hoengq. Duz cij duz aen dozsiengq de. Yungh «siu» roxnaeuz «Caiq guh» daeuj hoizfuk gij gaij neix. Rag dozsiengq gaenq baij daeuj gaij vih. Rag giz hoengq daeuj gaij giz yawj. Yungh song aen lwgfwngz doxdep roxnaeuz doxgyae daeuj cuengqhung roxnaeuz sukiq. «Yienh’ok sojmiz» gaij gij beijlaeh yawj hawj yawj daengx buek ndaej; mbouj gaij gij cikconq dozsiengq moq.

«Rom PNG» cigciep rom dozsiengq buek liux haenx. «Youq Paint gaij» aeu de haeuj giz gaij cawj, vuenh aen dozsiengq seizneix; siu ndaej. Dangh dozsiengq moq yaek yungh RAM lai gvaq gij RAM hawj yungh, miz yienh’ok gij senj guh aen iq di haenx couh senj de. Dangh dozsiengq iq lai lij yaek yungh RAM lai gvaq, aen yonjgen yienh’ok gij cawqhoeng RAM, mbouj hawj senj cikconq. Vwnzgen laiyenz yienzlaiz mbouj bienq. Buek seizneix rom youq gihgi neix; mwh mwngz dauqdaeuj, buek gag hai.

Gij cienghcawj neix yungh gij Catrobat/AGPL caeuq gij mingz boux guh dozsiengq doxdoengz, yienh’ok youq giz gaij cawj ndaw «Vwnzgen > Soqgawq AN Paint, gij hawj yungh caeuq boux guh».

ui_help23.source: Choose a tab to show its controls. View starts with Navigate; Draw contains Drawing, Selection and Insert. Navigate pans without drawing; pinch with two fingers to zoom. The arrow beside the tabs collapses the panel. All tools have labels. Edit changes the selection, canvas bounds, dimensions or image. Color selects foreground and background colors; Swap colors exchanges them and Black / white resets them. The color picker previews your choice immediately. Use colour confirms it; Cancel restores the previous color. Add colour or tap an empty saved slot to choose and save a colour. Hold a saved colour to edit or remove it. Advanced opens the detailed editor beside Black / white. Pixel grid also shows image-pixel rulers; cursor drawing shows live x/y beside zoom. Save as chooses an image format, compression settings and location; Save writes there again using those settings. Export as creates ICO, ASCII art or Base64 text without marking the drawing saved. Save and share saves a copy, then opens Android sharing. It keeps your current Save destination. Draw > Insert > Other images contains device files, Catrobat, Irasutoya, Openclipart and “Wikimedia Commons · Blank maps…”. Inserted images remain selected; the view shows their handles even outside the canvas. Fit image to canvas changes placement; Original size restores the source dimensions. Autosave restores the draft and both undo/redo stacks when you reopen the app. File also contains image assembly, How to use, and About, licences & credits. Insert text supports horizontal and vertical writing.
ui_help23.wording: Senj aen tab ndeu daeuj yienh’ok gij nauj yungh ndawde. «Yawj» haidaeuz miz «Rag daeuj yawj». «Veh» miz «Veh», «Senj» caeuq «Gya haeuj». «Rag daeuj yawj» rag giz yawj, mbouj veh; yungh song aen lwgfwngz doxdep roxnaeuz doxgyae daeuj cuengqhung roxnaeuz sukiq. Aen sienqdin haenz tab haenx hawj banj gap haeuj. Moix aen gipsaeh miz mingz. «Gaij» gaij gij senj, henz benq dieg veh, gij cikconq roxnaeuz dozsiengq. «Saek» senj saek baihnaj caeuq saek laeng; «Doxvuenh saek» doxvuenh song aen, «Ndam / hau» hoizfuk song aen. Giz senj saek cigciep yienh’ok gij saek mwngz senj haenx. «Yungh saek» dengqdingh de; «Cij» hoizfuk gij saek gaxgonq. Yungh «Gya saek» roxnaeuz diemj giz rom saek hoengq daeuj senj caeuq rom saek. Gaemz aen saek gaenq rom daeuj gaij roxnaeuz duz de. «Gij senj engq lai» hai giz gaij saek ciengz youq haenz «Ndam / hau». Gij sienq faen diemj saek dozsiengq hix yienh’ok cek ciuq diemj saek dozsiengq; «Veh yungh diemj biumingz giz veh» yienh’ok x/y seizneix youq haenz giz cuengqhung. «Rom baenz» senj yienghsiz dozsiengq, gij senj baenz iq caeuq giz rom. «Rom» caiq rom youq giz de ciuq gij senj haenx. «Lingh rom baenz» guh ICO, dozsiengq ASCII roxnaeuz saw Base64, mbouj biumingz dozsiengq gaenq rom. «Rom caeuq faenyiengj dozsiengq» lingh rom aen dozsiengq, caiq hai gij faenyiengj Android. Mbouj gaij giz «Rom» seizneix. «Veh > Gya haeuj > Dozsiengq wnq» miz vwnzgen ndaw gihgi, Catrobat, Irasutoya, Openclipart caeuq «Wikimedia Commons · Diegdoz hoengq…». Dozsiengq gya haeuj haenx lij dwg gij senj; giz yawj yienh’ok giz gaemz de, couhcinj youq rog benq dieg veh. «Gaij gij cikconq dozsiengq hawj hab benq dieg veh» gaij vih dozsiengq. «Gij cikconq yienzlaiz» hoizfuk gij cikconq laiyenz. Mwh caiq hai aen yonjgen, gag rom hoizfuk banjgienz gag rom caeuq song buek geijluz «siu» caeuq «Caiq guh». Ndaw «Vwnzgen» lij miz «Buek dozsiengq», «Coh yungh» caeuq «Soqgawq AN Paint, gij hawj yungh caeuq boux guh». Gya saw haeuj hawj sij daj baih swix daengz baih gvaz roxnaeuz daj gwnz daengz laj.

ui_the_arrow_on_the_left_directly_below_.source:
Choose View, Draw, File, Edit or Color to show that tab's controls. The arrow beside the tabs collapses or restores the panel. In portrait, the tabs and tool strip run horizontally; scroll them to reach more controls. In landscape, the tabs and primary tools run down the left. Draw contains Drawing, Selection and Insert. Drawing groups Pencil, Brush, Watercolor and Airbrush. Selection groups rectangular and free-form selections. Insert groups lines, shapes and text. Tap a category to select its remembered tool and show its tools and settings below the strip in portrait, or to its right in landscape. Tap the selected category again to collapse or expand its tools and settings. Categories remember the tool last used in them during the session. Scroll the options panel for further settings. The header contains the filename and quick actions. Credits & terms: «File > About, licences & credits».

The Color tab contains the FG/BG colour indicator, Swap colors, Black / white and Advanced. Tap the foreground or background part of the indicator to edit that colour. The standard palette and saved colours are below the header. Tap a standard swatch for foreground or hold for background. The four cells at the far right of the standard palette keep recent colours; tap for foreground or hold for background. The colour editor has Palette, Honeycomb and Advanced. Advanced has spectrum, wheel, RGB, HSV, HSL and six-digit hex controls. Custom colours start with Pale Violet #5B67FF, Gold #FFD700, Silver #C0C0C0 and Copper #B87333. Tap a saved colour to use it as foreground; hold it to choose background, edit or remove it. Add colour or an empty saved slot opens the editor to save a colour. The main document is opaque. Loading a transparent image as the canvas fills its transparent areas with the current BG colour. An inserted image remains a floating selection; its transparent areas reveal the existing canvas when committed. Wikimedia Commons imports receive a white backing before insertion. Original source files are unchanged.

View > Navigate: drag with one finger to pan, pinch with two fingers to zoom and pan. Choose Draw again in the Navigate options, or select a drawing tool, to return to drawing. Two-finger navigation also works in drawing tools without leaving paint marks. The bottom-right slider has a centre line at 100%. Zoom in/out buttons stop at 100% when a step would cross it; press again to continue. The adjacent Fit button fits and centres the canvas and any floating selection in the view. Navigate also provides 100%; View provides a pixel grid.

Autosave records the current draft after a short editing pause, and when you leave the app. The status shows Draft saved or an autosave error. Reopening restores the draft, filename, tool settings, floating selection and unfinished geometry. Autosave keeps a private working draft. File offers PNG, adjustable-quality JPEG and HEIC, and lossless or lossy JPEG XL, WebP and AVIF. Save as chooses the image format, settings and location; Save writes there again. Export as and Save and share write a copy without changing the current Save destination or marking the drawing saved. Save and share then opens Android sharing. The filename star means the drawing has unsaved changes. Source images are never overwritten by autosave.

Selections: draw a rectangle or free-form outline. Drag inside to move, drag a square corner or edge midpoint to resize, or drag the round Rotate handle to rotate. Lock proportions is on by default; switch it off to stretch width and height independently. Edge handles resize along the selected side. Free-form selections keep their selected shape within the transform box, including after rotation and autosave. The dimensions and angle appear in the options panel. Commit selection applies the result; selection edits can be undone, and autosave retains unfinished transforms. Copy, Cut and Crop to selection use the transformed image. Select all is under Edit > Selection, and Ctrl+A works on an external keyboard. Cut, Copy and Paste are quick actions in the header. Selection masks preserve the selected shape; the document itself remains opaque.

Canvas bounds: drag handles inward to trim or outward to expand on any side, then Apply bounds. New space uses BG; existing pixels are not scaled. Cancel and Undo are available. Resize image, Canvas size and New image also accept Pixels or Percent with an optional aspect lock.

Curve: draw a line and drag twice to bend it. Polygon: tap vertices, then double-tap the final vertex or use Finish polygon. Switch off Close polygon to draw connected open segments. Rounded rectangle: set Radius (px) with its slider; each shape limits the radius to half its shorter side. Text: tap the canvas, choose a font displayed in its own style and use the live preview. Options include size, bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, alignment, line spacing and a BG text box. Watercolor is in the Drawing category beside Brush and Airbrush; adjust strength for softer strokes. Pencil, brush and tool size sliders go up to 100 pixels. Pencil starts at 1 pixel and remembers its own width. Tap the displayed number for exact numeric entry. Heart, Star and Arrow have the same outline/fill choices as other shapes. View > Cursor drawing expands its enable switch, cursor shape and magnifier settings. Drag to position the cursor, tap the on-screen drawing button, then drag to move the cursor and draw. Tap again to stop drawing. Brush and stroke settings remain under Draw > Drawing. View > Magnifier lets you enable a magnified preview of the cursor or drawing point and adjust its magnification. Drawing settings also offers antialiasing and stroke smoothing. Eleven additional fonts are bundled; Font licences has their credits and full terms.

File > Load image replaces the canvas through Android's picker. «Draw → Insert → Other images» provides device files, Catrobat, Irasutoya, Openclipart and “Wikimedia Commons · Blank maps…”. Choose a device image, or open an online artwork page and tap «Use image», to add an image as a floating selection. File > About, licences & credits > Image credits keeps the source links and licence notice. Images within the device memory budget load at original resolution. If needed, a resize-choice dialog shows dimensions, pixel count and memory estimates, with Pixels/Percent sizing and optional aspect lock. The original file stays unchanged.

«File» > Image assembly opens a separate workspace for up to 20 images. Sort thumbnails by filename or time. Crop one image or batch-crop several. Same width / Same height normalizes all loaded images while preserving aspect ratios. Drag thumbnails or placed images to snap right/top aligned or bottom/left aligned. Exact position sets the top-left corner in whole pixels starting at zero, keeps other images fixed and permits overlaps. Images imported later are drawn on top. Unplace removes just the selected placement. Other images stay placed; attached images may move to fill the gap. «Show all» adjusts the view zoom. Save PNG exports the assembly; Edit in Paint transfers it as an undoable edit. The app uses one opaque image editor. Image assembly is a separate arrangement workspace.

The «File > About, licences & credits» panel includes original copyright, asset/font credits, full licence text and this version's complete source. Licence text scrolls independently of the fixed Copy all, Other terms and Done buttons.
ui_the_arrow_on_the_left_directly_below_.wording:
Senj «Yawj», «Veh», «Vwnzgen», «Gaij» roxnaeuz «Saek» daeuj yienh’ok gij nauj yungh ndaw tab de. Aen naq youq haenz tab rag rwt roxnaeuz mbe banj. Dangh gij bienhmak doengj, tab caeuq hangz gipsaeh baij daj swix daengz gvaz; ringx daeuj yawj gij nauj engq lai. Dangh gij bienhmak vangj, tab caeuq gij gipsaeh cawj baij daj gwnz daengz laj youq baih swix. «Veh» miz «Veh», «Senj» caeuq «Gya haeuj». «Veh» miz «Yienzbit», mauzbit, mauzbit veh henz myox caeuq «Cot saek». «Senj» miz gij senj yiengh seiq ciggak caeuq gij senj gag veh henz. «Gya haeuj» miz sienqdiuz, yiengh caeuq saw. Diemj cungj gipsaeh ndeu daeuj senj aen gipsaeh daengzcog yungh haenx, caeuq yienh’ok gij gipsaeh caeuq gij senj de youq laj hangz gipsaeh dangh bienhmak doengj, roxnaeuz youq baih gvaz de dangh bienhmak vangj. Caiq diemj cungj gipsaeh senj haenx daeuj rwt roxnaeuz mbe gij gipsaeh caeuq gij senj. Moix cungj gipsaeh geiq aen gipsaeh yungh doeklaeng mwh hai yonjgen baez neix. Ringx banj gij senj daeuj yawj gij senj engq lai. Banj gwnz miz mingz vwnzgen caeuq gij nauj yungh vaiq. Mingz boux guh caeuq gij diuzgienh: «Vwnzgen > Soqgawq AN Paint, gij hawj yungh caeuq boux guh».

Tab «Saek» miz giz yienh’ok FG/BG (saek baihnaj/baihlaeng), «Doxvuenh saek», «Dam / hau» caeuq «Gij senj engq lai». Diemj giz baihnaj roxnaeuz baihlaeng daeuj gaij gij saek haenx. Giz senj saek itbuen caeuq saek gaenq rom youq laj banj gwnz. Diemj aen saek itbuen daeuj yungh baenz saek baihnaj, roxnaeuz gaemh youq daeuj yungh baenz saek baihlaeng. Seiq giz ceiq gvaz ndaw giz senj saek itbuen rom gij saek yungh daengzcog; diemj daeuj yungh baihnaj, gaemh youq daeuj yungh baihlaeng. Giz gaij saek miz «Giz senj saek», «Rangh roengz» caeuq «Gij senj engq lai». «Gij senj engq lai» miz fanhbouh saek, vongz saek, RGB, HSV, HSL caeuq hex 6 aen cih. Saek gag dingh haidaeuz miz saek cijlanz onq #5B67FF, gim #FFD700, ngaenz #C0C0C0 caeuq doengz #B87333. Diemj saek gaenq rom daeuj yungh baenz saek baihnaj; gaemh youq daeuj senj baenz saek baihlaeng, gaij roxnaeuz duz. «Gya saek» roxnaeuz giz rom saek hoengq hai giz gaij saek daeuj rom saek. Vwnzgen cawj mbouj roengzdiemj. Hai dozsiengq roengzdiemj daeuj guh benq dieg veh seiz, aeu saek BG seizneix ndaemh gij giz roengzdiemj. Dozsiengq gya haeuj lij baenz gij senj yungh lingh gaij ndaej; mwh guh liux gij senj, gij giz roengzdiemj yienh’ok benq dieg veh gaenq miz. Dozsiengq daj Wikimedia Commons gya saek hau youq laeng sien, caiq gya haeuj. Vwnzgen laiyenz yienzlaiz mbouj bienq.

«Yawj > Rag daeuj yawj»: yungh aen lwgfwngz ndeu rag daeuj gaij giz yawj. Yungh song aen lwgfwngz doxdep roxnaeuz doxgyae daeuj cuengqhung roxnaeuz sukiq, caeuq rag daeuj gaij giz yawj. Caiq senj «Veh» ndaw gij senj «Rag daeuj yawj», roxnaeuz senj aen gipsaeh veh ndeu daeuj dauq veh. Mwh yungh gipsaeh veh, hix yungh song aen lwgfwngz daeuj gaij giz yawj ndaej, mbouj louz gij sienq veh. Diauz rag baih laj gvaz miz sienq cungqsim 100%. Dangh diemj nauj cuengqhung roxnaeuz sukiq hawj beijlaeh yaek gvaq 100%, de dingzcij youq 100%; caiq diemj couh gvaq. Nauj «Yawj daengx» youq haenz hawj benq dieg veh caeuq gij senj yungh lingh gaij ndaej yienh’ok daengx youq gyang giz yawj. «Rag daeuj yawj» hix hawj senj 100%; «Yawj» miz gij sienq faen diemj saek dozsiengq.

Gag rom rom banjgienz seizneix laeng dwk gaij itdi seizgan, caeuq mwh mwngz ok yonjgen. Gij cingqkuang yienh’ok «AN Paint gag rom lo» roxnaeuz gij loengloek gag rom. Caiq hai hoizfuk banjgienz, mingz vwnzgen, gij senj gipsaeh, gij senj yungh lingh gaij ndaej caeuq gij yiengh mbouj guh sat. Gag rom baujlouz banjgienz mwngz gag yungh. «Vwnzgen» hawj senj PNG, JPEG caeuq HEIC yungh gaij gij cizliengh ndaej, caeuq JPEG XL, WebP caeuq AVIF yungh rom mbouj siu roxnaeuz siu cizciet ndaej. «Rom baenz» senj yienghsiz dozsiengq, gij senj caeuq giz rom; «Rom» caiq rom youq giz de. «Lingh rom baenz» caeuq «Rom caeuq faenyiengj dozsiengq» lingh rom aen dozsiengq, mbouj gaij giz rom seizneix, caeuq mbouj biumingz dozsiengq gaenq rom. «Rom caeuq faenyiengj dozsiengq» caiq hai gij faenyiengj Android. Miz aen sing youq haenz mingz vwnzgen dwg gangj gij veh lij miz gaij mbouj rom. Gag rom mbouj rom daengz gwnz dozsiengq laiyenz.

Gij senj: veh yiengh seiq ciggak roxnaeuz gag veh sienq henz. Rag ndaw gij senj daeuj gaij vih, rag aen gok seiqfang roxnaeuz giz gaemz gyang henz daeuj gaij cikconq, roxnaeuz rag aen giz gaemz luenz «Baenq» daeuj baenq. «Hawj beijlaeh gvangq / sang mbouj bienq» gag hai; gven de couh gaij gvangq caeuq sang gak de ndaej. Giz gaemz henz gaij cikconq ciuq baih senj. Gij senj gag veh henz baujlouz yiengh senj ndaw aen kuengq yungh gaij, couhcinj laeng baenq caeuq gag rom. Gij cikconq caeuq soqdoq baenq youq ndaw banj gij senj. «Guh liux gij senj» yungh gij gaij. Gij gaij senj siu ndaej, caeuq gag rom baujlouz gij gaij mbouj sat. Lingh guh, Daet caeuq «Ciuq gij senj daet henz» yungh dozsiengq gaenq gaij. «Senj sojmiz» youq «Gaij > Senj»; gienhbanj daj rog yungh Ctrl+A hix ndaej. Daet, lingh guh caeuq nem dwg nauj yungh vaiq youq banj gwnz. Gij menqgaiq gij senj baujlouz gij yiengh senj; vwnzgen gag de lij mbouj roengzdiemj.

«Henz benq dieg veh»: rag giz gaemz haeujndaw daeuj daet henz, roxnaeuz okrog daeuj dem dieg ciuq baih yaek gaij, caiq yungh «Yungh gij henz neix». Giz moq yungh saek BG; gij diemj saek gaenq miz mbouj gaij cikconq. Yungh «Fwtqfex» caeuq «siu» ndaej. Gaij cikconq dozsiengq, cikconq benq dieg veh caeuq «Dozsiengq moq» hix yungh diemj saek dozsiengq roxnaeuz beijlaeh moix bak faenh ndaej, dengq mwngz senj yaek hawj beijlaeh gvangq/sang mbouj bienq roxnaeuz mbouj yaek.

Sienq ngveiq: veh diauz sienq ndeu, caiq rag song baez hawj de ngveiq. «Ciep gij sienq soh»: diemj gij gok, caiq diemj gok doeklaeng song baez, roxnaeuz yungh «Veh liux gij sienq soh ciep haenx». Gven «Ciep diemj daih’it caeuq diemj doeklaeng» daeuj veh ndiep sienq soh doxcip mbouj ciep song doengz. «Yiengh seiq ciggak, gij gok luenz»: rag nauj daeuj dingh gij soq gok luenz (px); moix aen yiengh hawj gij soq gok luenz ceiq lai dwg buenq diauz henz duenh di haenx. Saw: diemj benq dieg veh, senj yiengh cih yienh’ok ciuq gij yiengh de, caeuq yungh gij yawj sien seizneix. Miz senj cikconq, cih co, cih ngeng, sienqdiuz laj cih, sienqdiuz gvaq cih, coh baij cih, giz hoengq gyang hangz caeuq kuengq saw yungh saek BG. Mauzbit veh henz myox youq cungj «Veh», youq haenz mauzbit caeuq «Cot saek»; gaij gij rengz daeuj veh gij sienq onq di. Nauj rag cikconq yienzbit, mauzbit caeuq gipsaeh hawj daengz 100 diemj saek dozsiengq. Yienzbit haidaeuz 1 diemj saek dozsiengq caeuq geiq gij gvangq gag miz. Diemj gij soq yienh’ok haenx daeuj sij gij soq cinj. Sim, «Sing» caeuq «Naq» miz gij senj sienq henz caeuq ndaemh saek doxgij yiengh wnq. «Yawj > Veh yungh diemj biumingz giz veh» mbe nauj hai/gven, gij yiengh diemj biumingz caeuq gij senj yawj giz veh cuengqhung. Rag daeuj dingh vih diemj biumingz; diemj nauj veh gwnz bienhmak, caiq rag daeuj doengh diemj biumingz caeuq veh. Caiq diemj daeuj dingzcij veh. Gij senj mauzbit caeuq coh maenh veh lij youq «Veh > Veh». «Yawj > Yawj giz veh cuengqhung» hawj hai gij yawj sien cuengqhung diemj biumingz roxnaeuz diemj veh, caeuq gaij gij beijlaeh cuengqhung. «Gij senj veh» hix miz gij guh henz mbouj bienq baenz gaeq ras, caeuq gij guh sienq veh laj di. Yonjgen hix miz 11 cungj yiengh cih dem; «Gij hawj yungh yiengh cih» miz mingz boux guh caeuq gij diuzgienh daengx.

«Vwnzgen > Hai dozsiengq» yungh giz senj vwnzgen Android daeuj vuenh benq dieg veh. «Veh → Gya haeuj → Dozsiengq wnq» miz vwnzgen ndaw gihgi, Catrobat, Irasutoya, Openclipart caeuq «Wikimedia Commons · Diegdoz hoengq…». Senj dozsiengq ndaw gihgi, roxnaeuz hai mbaw dozsiengq ndaw vangj caiq diemj «Yungh dozsiengq», daeuj gya dozsiengq haeuj baenz gij senj yungh lingh gaij ndaej. «Vwnzgen > Soqgawq AN Paint, gij hawj yungh caeuq boux guh > Mingz boux guh dozsiengq» rom lienzcaep laiyenz caeuq gij cihsih hawj yungh. Dangh RAM ndaw gihgi gaeuq, hai dozsiengq ciuq cikconq yienzlaiz. Dangh yaekaeu, banj gaij cikconq yienh’ok cikconq, soq diemj saek dozsiengq caeuq RAM gaisuenq, hawj senj diemj saek dozsiengq roxnaeuz beijlaeh moix bak faenh, caeuq senj baujlouz beijlaeh gvangq/sang. Vwnzgen yienzlaiz mbouj bienq.

«Vwnzgen > Buek dozsiengq» hai dieg guhsaeh lingh miz, hawj yungh ceiq lai 20 aen dozsiengq. Baiz dozsiengq iq ciuq mingz vwnzgen roxnaeuz seizgan. Daet henz aen dozsiengq ndeu roxnaeuz daet henz lai aen. «Gvangq doxdoengz / Sang doxdoengz» hawj dozsiengq haeuj de miz cikconq doxdoengz, hoeng baujlouz beijlaeh gvangq/sang moix aen gag miz. Rag dozsiengq iq roxnaeuz dozsiengq gaenq baij daeuj ciep youq baih gvaz, henz gwnz doxndaengz, roxnaeuz youq baih laj, henz swix doxndaengz. «Vih cinj» dingh gok gwnz baih swix ciuq cingjsoq diemj saek dozsiengq haidaeuz 0, mbouj hawj dozsiengq wnq doengh, caeuq hawj doxdep ndaej. Dozsiengq haeuj laeng haenx yienh’ok youq gwnz. Cij aeu dozsiengq senj haenx ok daj dieg baij. Dozsiengq wnq lij gaenq baij; gij dozsiengq ciep giz de hoengjlau yaek doengh daeuj ndaemh giz hoengq. «Yienh’ok sojmiz» gaij beijlaeh yawj. «Rom PNG» lingh rom buek dozsiengq; «Youq Paint gaij» aeu buek haeuj giz gaij, siu gij gaij de ndaej. Yonjgen yungh aen giz gaij dozsiengq mbouj roengzdiemj ndeu. Buek dozsiengq dwg dieg guhsaeh lingh miz daeuj baij dozsiengq.

Banj «Vwnzgen > Soqgawq AN Paint, gij hawj yungh caeuq boux guh» miz banjgienz yienzlaiz, mingz boux guh dozsiengq caeuq yiengh cih, gij saw hawj yungh daengx caeuq daengx gij daimaex laiyenz banj neix. Ringx gij saw hawj yungh mbouj hawj nauj «Lingh guh sojmiz daeuj nem», «Diuzgienh eiz» caeuq «Baenz le» doengh.

ui_help23.source: Choose a tab to show its controls. View starts with Navigate; Draw contains Drawing, Selection and Insert. Navigate pans without drawing; pinch with two fingers to zoom. The arrow beside the tabs collapses the panel. All tools have labels. Edit changes the selection, canvas bounds, dimensions or image. Color selects foreground and background colors; Swap colors exchanges them and Black / white resets them. The color picker previews your choice immediately. Use colour confirms it; Cancel restores the previous color. Add colour or tap an empty saved slot to choose and save a colour. Hold a saved colour to edit or remove it. Advanced opens the detailed editor beside Black / white. Pixel grid also shows image-pixel rulers; cursor drawing shows live x/y beside zoom. Save as chooses an image format, compression settings and location; Save writes there again using those settings. Export as creates ICO, ASCII art or Base64 text without marking the drawing saved. Save and share saves a copy, then opens Android sharing. It keeps your current Save destination. Draw > Insert > Other images contains device files, Catrobat, Irasutoya, Openclipart and “Wikimedia Commons · Blank maps…”. Inserted images remain selected; the view shows their handles even outside the canvas. Fit image to canvas changes placement; Original size restores the source dimensions. Autosave restores the draft and both undo/redo stacks when you reopen the app. File also contains image assembly, How to use, and About, licences & credits. Insert text supports horizontal and vertical writing.
ui_help23.wording: Xictlapehpeni ce pestana para tiquittaz tlen hueli ticchihuaz. «Xiquitta» pehua ica «Xictotoxo ixcopincayotl para tiquittaz»; pan «Xicpa» oncah tlen hueli ica titlapa, «Xictlapehpeni» huan «Xictlali». Tlan zan tictotoxoa para tiquittaz, ax titlapa. Ica ome momahpil xicnechco zo xiciyocatlali para ma neci maz huei zo maz cuecuetztzin. Mitl tlen eltoc ininacas pestanas quitzacua campa neci tlen hueli ticchihuaz. Nochi tlen ica titequiti quipiya itoca. «Xicpatla» quipatla tlen tictlapehpenqui, inepamitl campa titlapa, ihuexca zo ixcopincayotl. «Ixnezcayotl» quipiya ixnezcayotl tlen mocahua iixpan huan iica; «Xicpatla iixpan huan iica» quincuepa, huan «Zampa xictequihui yayahuic / chipahuac» zampa quintlalia. Nimantzin neci ixnezcayotl tlen tictlapehpenia. «Xictequihui ni ixnezcayotl» quicahua nopa ixnezcayotl; tlan ticcahua ni tequitl, zampa mocahua ixnezcayotl tlen achtohui. «Xicahcocui ixnezcayotl» zo xictlali huan nimantzin xicquixti momahpil pan ce lugar tlen axquipiya ixnezcayotl para tictlapehpeniz huan ticahcocuiz ce ixnezcayotl. Xiccahua momahpil pan ce ixnezcayotl tlen quiahcoucqui AN Paint para ticpatlaz zo ticquixtiz. «Achi miac tlen hueli ticpatlaz», inacas yayahuic / chipahuac, quitlapoa campa hueli ticpatlaz ocsequi tlen quipiya ixnezcayotl. «Inepamitl cehce pixel» noihqui quimanextia reglas ica pixels; quemman titlapa ica cursor, neci x/y campa eltoc namantzin inacas tlen quipatla quen huei neci ixcopincayotl. «Xicahcocui» hueli quicahua tictlapehpeniz tlamantli amatl, quen ticpitzahuaz huan campa ticahcocuiz; tlan zan ticahcocui zampa, quintequihuia nopa tlen tictlapehpenqui. Tlan ticquixtia ce copia, AN Paint quichihua ICO, ixcopincayotl ica ASCII zo tlahcuilolli Base64, zan axquimanextia quen ixcopincayotl tlen ya quiahcoucqui. «Xicahcocui huan xictitlani» quiahcocui ce copia, teipan quitlapoa campa Android quititlani; axquipatla campa ticahcocui namantzin. Pan «Xicpa → Xictlali → Cequinoc ixcopincayotl» oncah amatl tlen dispositivo, Catrobat, Irasutoya, Openclipart huan «Wikimedia Commons · Tlaltlachiyaliztli tlen axquipiya tlahcuilolli…». Ixcopincayotl tlen ticcalactia mocahua tlapehpentoc; neci campa hueli tiquihcuenia, noihqui tlan eltoc quiyahuac campa titlapa. Tlan tictlalia ixcopincayotl ma eli iihtic campa titlapa, mopatla campa eltoc; «Ihuexca tlen achtohui» zampa quicahua quen eltoya ihuexca. Tlen AN Paint quiahcocui icelti zampa mocahua quemman zampa tictlapoa, huan hueli tictequihuia «Zampa xiccahua quen eltoya» huan «Zampa xicchihua» ica tlen eltoya achtohui. «Amatl» noihqui quipiya tlatecpanilli tlen ixcopincayotl, quen tictequihuiz AN Paint huan «Tlahcuiloliztli tlen AN Paint, licencias huan acquiya quichiuhqui ni tequitl». Tlan tictlalia tlahcuilolli, hueli tictlalia tlen iarrabez hasta inemah zo tlen itzonco hasta itzintlan.

ui_add_up_to_20_images_with_android_s.source:
Add up to 20 images with Android's file picker. The bottom tray shows thumbnails, filenames, image dimensions after cropping and any Same width or Same height adjustment, and file modification times when supplied by the provider. Sort by filename or modification time; sorting does not rearrange placed images.

Tap a thumbnail to select it. Crop image trims that image; Batch crop applies pixel or percentage margins to selected images. Drag crop handles or type amounts. Reset crop restores the original edges. Cropping is non-destructive and can be undone.

Hold a thumbnail, or drag an image already in the workspace, then drop it onto a highlighted edge. The translucent preview shows the exact snapped result. A right attachment aligns the tops; a bottom attachment aligns the left edges. You can also tap a thumbnail and then a + target. When snapping, the first image starts at the origin. Attached images may move when their parent is cropped. Overlaps are rejected when snapping.

Select an image and use Exact position to set its top-left X/Y coordinates in whole pixels, starting at zero. Other images keep their positions, and overlaps are allowed.

Same width and Same height give every input a common dimension while preserving each image's own aspect ratio. Choose pixels, percent, Smallest or Largest. Restore original sizes removes normalization and keeps crops.

Unplace returns only the selected image to the tray. Other images stay placed; attached images may move to fill the gap. Remove deletes only that input. Undo/Redo restore these changes. Drag a placed image to rearrange it; empty-space dragging pans. Pinch to zoom. «Show all» adjusts the zoom to show the whole assembly; it never changes output dimensions.

Save PNG saves the assembled image directly. Edit in Paint transfers it into the main editor as an undoable replacement. If the output exceeds the memory budget, choose a smaller output copy if offered. If even a tiny output exceeds the budget, the app shows a memory warning instead of a size chooser. Original source files stay unchanged. The current assembly is stored locally and reopens when you return.

This mode uses the same Catrobat/AGPL and asset credits shown in the main editor's «File > About, licences & credits» panel.
ui_add_up_to_20_images_with_android_s.wording:
Xictlali hasta 20 ixcopincayotl ica campa Android mitzchihualtia xictlapehpeni amatl. Itzintlan neci ixcopincayotl cuecuetztzitzi, inintoca amatl, ihuexca ixcopincayotl satepan tlen tictequi huan tlen ticpatla ica «San ce ipatlauhca» zo «San ce ihuahcapanyo», huan quemman quipatlaque amatl tlan quitemaca nopa tlahcuiloliztli campa ticcui amatl. Xiquintecpana ica inintoca amatl zo quemman quipatlaque. Ixcopincayotl tlen ya tictlalih axmoolinia.

Xictlali huan nimantzin xicquixti momahpil pan ce ixcopincayotl cuecuetztzin para tictlapehpeniz. «Xictequi ixcopincayotl» quitequi san nopa ixcopincayotl; tlan tiquintequi miac san ce huelta, hueli tictlalia quezqui pixels zo por ciento ticquixtiz pan itenno cehce ixcopincayotl tlen tictlapehpenqui. Xictotoxo campa hueli tiquihcuenia itenno zo xiquihcuilo quezqui ticquixtiz. «Zampa xiccahua quen eltoya itenno» zampa quicahua itenno quen eltoya. Tlan tictequi, axquipatla amatl tlen achtohui, huan hueli zampa ticcahua quen eltoya.

Xiccahua momahpil ce tlatoctzin pan ixcopincayotl cuecuetztzin, zo xictotoxo ce ixcopincayotl tlen ya tictlalih; xiccahua pan itenno tlen neci ocachi. Campa neci ixcopincayotl quen hueli titlachia iica, tiquitta canin mochijtoc tlan mopepechoa. Tlan mopepechoa pan inemah, motlalia san ce campa itzonco; tlan mopepechoa itzintlan, motlalia san ce campa iarrabez. Noihqui hueli xictlapehpeni ixcopincayotl cuecuetztzin huan teipa +. Tlan mopepechoa ixcopincayotl, tlen achtohui pehua pan (0, 0). Tlan tictequi ixcopincayotl campa mopepechojtoque ocsequi, nopa ocsequi hueli moolinia. Tlan mopepechoa ixcopincayotl, axhueli mocahua ce ixcopincayotl ipan ceyoc.

Xictlapehpeni ce ixcopincayotl huan xictequihui campa hueli tictlalia melahuac para tictlaliz X/Y tlen itzonco iarrabez, ica pixels enteros tlen pehua pan 0. Ocsequi ixcopincayotl mocahua campa eltoya, huan hueli mocahua ce ipan ceyoc.

«San ce ipatlauhca» huan «San ce ihuahcapanyo» quintlalia nochi ixcopincayotl san ce ipatlauhca zo ihuahcapanyo, zan cehce quicahua quen eltoya ipatlauhca ica ihuahcapanyo. Xictlapehpeni pixels, por ciento, tlen ocachi cuecuetztzin zo tlen ocachi huei. Xiccuepa ihuexca tlen achtohui para nochi occepa quipiya ihuexca tlen eltoya, zan mocahua tlen tictequi.

Tlan tiquihcuenia, san ixcopincayotl tlen tictlapehpenqui mocuepa itzintlan. Ocsequi mocahua campa eltoya; tlen mopepechtoque hueli moolinia para quitemitiz campa polihui. Tlan ticquixtia, san nopa ixcopincayotl mopohpohua. «Zampa xiccahua quen eltoya» huan «Zampa xicchihua» quicuepa tlen mopatlac. Xictotoxo ce ixcopincayotl tlen ya tictlalih para tiquihcueniz; xictotoxo campa axoncah ixcopincayotl para tihcueniz tlen tiquitta. Ica ome momahpil xicnechco zo xiciyocatlali para ma neci maz huei zo maz cuecuetztzin. «Xiquitta nochi» quipatla quen huei neci para ma tiquitta nochi nopa tlatecpanilli; axquipatla ihuexca ixcopincayotl tlen AN Paint quichihuaz.

«Xicahcocui (PNG)» quiahcocui nopa ixcopincayotl tlatecpanilli. «Xicpatla pan Paint» quihuica campa titequiti para quipatla ixcopincayotl tlen eltoya; hueli zampa ticcahua quen eltoya. Tlan monequi ocachi RAM que tlen hueli motequihuia, xictlapehpeni ce copia maz cuecuetztzin tlan hueli. Tlan ce copia tlahuel cuecuetztzin noihqui monequi ocachi RAM, AN Paint mitzilhuiya axahci RAM, axmitzmanextia campa tictlapehpeniz ihuexca. Amatl tlen achtohui axmopatlaj. Tlatecpanilli mocahua pan ni dispositivo huan zampa motlapoa quemman timochicuepa.

Nican motequihuia sa no nopa Catrobat/AGPL huan tlahcuiloliztli tlen quimanextia acquiya quichijqui tlen motequihuia, quen neci campa titequiti pan «Amatl → Tlahcuiloliztli tlen AN Paint, licencias huan acquiya quichiuhqui ni tequitl».

gallery_description.source: Tap Use image to insert immediately. Copy credit beside an image copies its title, publisher, source and licence for your publication. Catrobat's original artwork is CC BY-SA 4.0; keep any separately named creators, copyright and other source notices. Describe your edits and share adaptations under CC BY-SA 4.0 or a compatible licence. Edit credits lets you add these details; inserted sources remain under File → About, licences & credits → Image credits.
gallery_description.wording: Xictequihui «Xictequihui ni ixcopincayotl» para ticcalactiz nimantzin. Campa eltoc inacas ixcopincayotl tlen ica ticcopinaz, mocopina itoca, acquiya quimanextih, campa mocui huan licencia para tlen ticmanextiz. Ixcopincayotl tlen Catrobat quichijqui achtohui quitequihuiaj CC BY-SA 4.0. Xiccahua inintoca acquiya quichijque tlen moijtoaj ihiyoca, derechos de autor, huan ocsequi tlahcuiloliztli campa mocui. Xiquijcuilo tlen ticpatlac huan xictitlani ixcopincayotl tlen ticpatlac ica CC BY-SA 4.0 zo ceyoc licencia tlen hueli motequihuia san sejco. Campa ticpatla tlahcuiloliztli tlen quimanextia acquiya quichijqui hueli tictlalia ni tlahcuiloliztli. Campa mocui nopa ixcopincayotl tlen ticcalactih mocahua pan «Amatl → Tlahcuiloliztli tlen AN Paint, licencias huan acquiya quichiuhqui ni tequitl → Tlen quimanextia acquiya quichiuhqui ixcopincayotl».
